title: absurd-predication-cell
description: The absurd, over-determined corner of the predication cell's slot-presence partition - both subject and object slots committed at once (the knowledge-top corner of the four-point form shared with the articulation cell and the bilattice charge). It refines the predication cell by fixing both slot-presence statuses positive.

subject-committed.description: the subject slot of phi = (s, p, o) is committed

object-committed.description: the object slot of phi = (s, p, o) is committed - both at once gives the over-determined knowledge-top corner
